title: KDE Gwenview PNG File Parsing Integer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-126973)
description: A vulnerability in KDE Gwenview's PNG file parsing allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted PNG file. The flaw is due to an integer overflow caused by improper validation of user-supplied data during PNG parsing, leading to unsafe buffer allocation. Exploitation requires user interaction, such as opening a malicious file or visiting a malicious page.
